about.intro: Virtelon is a small, senior software & AI studio out of India, building for clients worldwide. No account-manager layer, no offshore black box — you work directly with the people writing your code.
story: We started Virtelon because too much software is over-promised, over-priced and under-delivered.

We're a founder-led team that would rather build a handful of things properly than churn out templates. The same people who scope your project design it, build it and ship it — so nothing gets lost in translation.
Our ambition is to grow Virtelon into a serious technology company — but the way we work stays the same: direct, honest, and obsessed with what actually ships.
